Name: RSV_portrait_adjsutment
Author: TD2003
Description:
我没做什么大的调整，仅对几个我看不下去的肖像进行了微调。（小型整容手术）
其他角色、泳装我都还没调整，因为我昨天晚上就花了几个小时做这件事。（[b][s]因为我还没玩到后面！[/s][/b]）后续等我有空再继续调整，以后还想稍微调整一下SVE的几个角色。
I didn't make any major changes, just did some minor 'plastic surgery' on a few portraits I couldn't stand looking at. I haven't touched the other characters or the swimsuit outfits yet because I only spent a few hours on this last night. (And because I haven't gotten that far in the game!) I'll continue adjusting them when I have time, and I'd like to tweak a few characters from SVE in the future.

Downloads.Description: 将png拖入里奇赛德村的模组文件中，路径大概是Ridgeside Village\[CP] Ridgeside Village\Assets\Portraits，直接替换原版png即可
